row.retriever: Local SQLite Vault + Self-Info Coherence & Event-Cluster Ranking (0-Vector)

protocol.pipeline: Official SGM corpus (11,034 items) ingested into an isolated local SQLite vault with zero LLM calls and zero vector embeddings. Retrieval is deterministic and answer-model independent; top-10 ranked items are passed to the answer model using the exact official MMRAG SYSTEM and USER_TEXT prompts.
